stories.story_title: XPRIZE $11M Autonomous Wildfire Finals Live in NANA Region / Nenana, June 15-25
stories.note: 5 teams (Anduril, Data Blanket, Dryad, FireSwarm, Wildfire Quest), 1,000 km2 zone near Nenana, ACUASI/UAF partner, $3.5M/track + $1M Lockheed detection bonus. ALREADY-MINED entity (used as texture 06-17). Live this week is the fresh hook.

stories.story_title: NSF Reverses Course, Preserves Ocean Observatories Initiative (autonomous gliders, AK-adjacent Pacific) after Murkowski-led pushback
stories.note: NSF reversal of OOI decommission. OOI was 06-17 LEAD; this is the resolution. 900+ instruments preserved. Feeds NOAA AK fisheries stock assessments.

stories.story_title: AK Rural Health Transformation Program advances 400+ proposals incl. TCC drone pharmacy delivery; AI = 22% of submissions
stories.note: OUT OF WINDOW (June 7-9). $272M RHTP allocation; full apps due June 22, awards July. TCC drone vaccine delivery 27 communities/5yr. Useful as forward-look/background only.

notes: SLOW WEEK. One strong in-window primary deployment (XPRIZE, but mined entity). NSF OOI reversal in-window (resolves prior lead). No in-window oil&gas/mining/aviation/defense-logistics/SAR deployments found. RHTP/TCC is out-of-window background but a strong forward-look (July awards).
